records.name: Quash

records.description: Quash is an intent-driven mobile testing tool that lets you write and run tests in plain language instead of scripts. You can run tests on real devices, cloud devices or local emulators. Quash adapts when the UI changes using built-in self healing, understands app behavior across builds, supports backend validations, reusable test data, test suites and running tests in parallel. Every run generates detailed execution reports with step level intent, actions and screenshots.

records.name: PolyLingo
